HomeHeading: Where do you want to play?
HomeDescription: Select a display and choose what it does. Displays you turn off are restored automatically when you leave the game.
TourRoleDescription: With a display selected, choose whether to play on it, turn it off while you play, or leave it on. Displays you turn off are restored when you leave.
TourPlayDescription: Your displays switch and Big Picture opens on the TV. The first time, the TV asks you to confirm that you can see the image; if nobody responds within 15 sec, everything is restored. Close Big Picture to leave.
RunningInTray: You can close this window; Console Mode will keep running in the system tray.
SettingsIntro: Changes are saved automatically. Choose displays on the home screen.
HideOtherScreensCard: How to turn off other displays
HideOtherScreensDescription: Disconnecting is fastest. The black screen keeps the layout unchanged; DDC/CI turns off the panel through its hardware.
HdrDescription: Enabled on entry and restored to its previous state on exit.
VrrDescription: Enables the Windows setting. Also enable it in the NVIDIA/AMD control panel.
UiModeDescription: Console: big cards and controller navigation, full screen. Automatic picks Console when a controller is connected.
ControllerHintDesktop: Controller detected · A navigates, Y opens console mode
SessionMenuHint: Select + Y opens this menu at any time.
SessionMenuDescription: During a session, hold Select + Y to open a menu over the game: volume, resolution, audio, FPS, HDR, back to the PC or exit. Does not work over exclusive-fullscreen games.
ConsoleSettingsHint: Press A on a row to change its value. Everything is saved right away.
ConsoleActiveHint: Or hold Start + Select on the controller for 1 second.
HomeButtonCard: Open with the controller Home button
HomeButtonDescription: With the app in the tray, hold the Xbox button for 1 second to enter console mode. During a session, hold Start + Select for 1 second to go back to the PC. Xbox (XInput) controllers only.
AutoStartControllerDescription: With the app in the tray, turning on or plugging in a controller enters console mode. Ignores the first 15 s after opening and 30 s after restoring.
HomeButtonShortPressCard: Short press of the Xbox button
HomeButtonShortPressDescription: Just press it, no holding. Turns off the controller shortcut for Game Bar in Windows (Win+G keeps working).
HomeButtonSteamHint: Steam is open and also uses the Xbox button. In Steam, turn off "Guide button focuses Steam" for the short press to work.
GameBarSettingError: Could not change the Game Bar setting: {0}
StartupDescription: Opens in the system tray when your PC starts, ready for the one-click shortcut.
NotifyUpdatesCard: Notify me when a new version is available
NotifyUpdatesDescription: Checks GitHub releases when the app starts.
TvConfirmationDescription: The first time you use a new gaming display, the TV asks you to confirm that you can see the image. Respond with a mouse, keyboard, or controller (Xbox: A/B · PlayStation: ✕/○). Test it here without changing your displays.
TutorialDescription: Show the home screen walkthrough again.
OneClickDescription: Creates "Console Mode 1 Click" on your desktop, next to the regular app shortcut. It enters console mode directly without opening this window.
DataFolderDescription: Settings, display backup, and the log file (consolemode.log).
LanguageDescription: Choose the language used in Console Mode.
ConfirmDescription: This is the gaming display. Confirm with your mouse, keyboard, or controller. If nobody responds, your displays will be restored automatically.
AudioHint: Applied on entry and restored on exit. "When connected" switches automatically when the TV appears.
LaunchPlayniteDescription: Opens Playnite in fullscreen. Your displays are restored automatically when you close it.
LaunchXboxDescription: Experimental: sends Win+F11. To restore your displays, use the app or system tray menu.
LaunchSteamDescription: Opens Steam Big Picture. Your displays are restored automatically when you close it.
FocusChoose: Choose a gaming display on the home screen.
FocusApplied: Applied to {0} on entry and reverted on exit.
PlaynitePathDetected: Found automatically at {0}. Pick Playnite.FullscreenApp.exe if you use the portable version.
PlaynitePathMissing: Playnite not found. Pick Playnite.FullscreenApp.exe (portable version, for example).
PlaynitePathPickError: Could not open the file picker: {0}
FpsAvailable: Applies to all games while console mode is active. Uses RTSS.
FpsUnavailable: Optional. Install RivaTuner Statistics Server (RTSS) to use this feature.
NoGameDisplayConfigured: No gaming display is configured; unable to enter console mode.
AudioOnConnect: The one that appears when connected (TV)
SvvMissing: SoundVolumeView.exe was not found in ConsoleMode_Data/tools; audio switching is disabled.
ShortcutCreated: Created the "Console Mode 1 Click" desktop shortcut.
ChooseGameScreen: Choose the display you want to play on.
UnconfirmedSetup: Your displays were restored because the gaming display wasn't confirmed. Check your selection and try again.
ShortcutDescription: Enters console mode with one click
ShortcutUnavailable: WScript.Shell is unavailable on this version of Windows.
UpdateAssetMissing: This release doesn't have a verifiable asset for this installation type.
UpdateHashMismatch: The downloaded file's SHA-256 does not match the digest published by GitHub.
TourMapGeneric: These are your displays in their desktop positions. Select the display you want to play on.
TourMapWithFocus: These are your displays in their desktop positions. We chose {0} because it is currently turned off; select another if you prefer.
RestoreSuccess: Your displays are back to normal.
SummaryChooseScreen: Choose the display you want to play on
GameScreenDidNotTurnOn: The gaming display did not turn on. Check that the TV is on and set to the right HDMI input, then try again.
ActivePlaynite: Close Playnite to restore your displays automatically.
ActiveXbox: In Xbox mode, restoration is manual: use Restore now or the system tray menu.
ActiveSteam: Close Big Picture to restore your displays automatically.
StartupSettingError: Could not change the Windows startup setting: {0}
AppUpToDate: Console Mode is up to date.
NewVersionOnGithub: A new version is available on GitHub.
